description.zh: 开启SQL审计的数据库名称。
description.en: The name of the database for which to enable SQL audit.
The instance ID of the DRDS instance.

description.zh: 是否回溯历史SQL进行审计。
description.en: Specifies whether to recall historical SQL statements for auditing.

description.zh:
回溯结束时间，格式为时间戳（单位为毫秒）。
>回溯结束时间需晚于开始时间。
description.en:
The end time of the recall period. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
>The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh: 回溯开始时间，格式为时间戳（单位为毫秒）。
description.en: The start time of the recall period. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds enable-sql-audit --drds-instance-id drds00000000000 --db-name test --is-recall true --recall-start-timestamp 1568875132000 --recall-end-timestamp 1568875132000 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds EnableSqlAudit --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds00000000000 --IsRecall true --RecallStartTimestamp 1568875132000 --RecallEndTimestamp 1568875132000 --DbName test
